Feature.Description: Run robot controller tasks (programs) by name on a DENSO robot controller over b-CAP, and list available task names. The server is stateless: each command opens a b-CAP connection, acquires the task handle, performs the operation, then releases the handle and disconnects.

Command.Description: Start a controller task in one-cycle mode (mode 1) by name. This is an observable command. In v1 the command only starts the task and then waits a fixed interval (configured by 'run_wait_seconds', default 10 s) before completing; it does not yet detect actual task completion. The observable form is kept so completion detection can be added later without changing the interface.

Parameter.Description: The name of the controller task (program) to start.

Response.Description: True if the task was started successfully.

Command.Description: List the names of all available controller tasks.

Response.Description: The list of controller task names.

DefinedExecutionError.Description: Failed to connect to or communicate with the robot controller over b-CAP.
Failed to access or start the requested task (e.g. the task name does not exist or start was rejected).
